controls.positive: the transcribed rules against the class; the class against the BPS chart
controls.negative: the rules with the opposite orientation

notes: The draft's figure places vertex i at angle 90 - 360 i / 7 degrees, i.e. its indices increase clockwise; the rules hold with increasing index, so the text's 'CCW' is clockwise in that figure.

checks.name: the draft's c_ab rule and quantum Ptolemy rule, transcribed from the text, reproduce A1A2kKAlg(k) on every ordered pair of letters, k = 1..6 (at k = 6: 5370/5370 q-commuting, 2730/2730 Ptolemy), with 'CCW' read as increasing vertex index

negative control: with the opposite orientation the Ptolemy rule fails on every crossing pair (k = 6: 3690/5370, 0/2730), so the orientation is load-bearing -- and it is the one in which the draft's heptagon figure numbers its vertices clockwise
every term of every letter product is a non-crossing multiset of chords, k = 1..6
the draft's m(a) (a/2 for even a, k - (a-1)/2 for odd a) is the class's, k = 1..6
the class's letter products equal the BPS chart's (A_2k quiver, default spec) through the additive charge map, on every ordered pair: k=1 25/25, k=2 196/196, k=3 729/729
